query:
mutation CommentCreate { commentCreate(input: { issueId: "KLA-241", body: "## 📊 48h Observation Report

**Period:** {{PERIOD}}
**Timestamp:** {{TIMESTAMP}}

### Metrics
| Metric | Value | Threshold | Status |
|--------|-------|-----------|--------|
| Win Rate | {{WIN_RATE}} | >55% | {{WIN_STATUS}} |
| Max DD | {{MAX_DD}} | <6% | {{DD_STATUS}} |
| Sharpe | {{SHARPE}} | >1.5 | {{SHARPE_STATUS}} |
| MTF Block | {{MTF_BLOCK}} | 25-40% | {{MTF_STATUS}} |
| Avg Position | {{AVG_POS}} | <2.5% | {{POS_STATUS}} |
| P0 Errors | {{P0_ERRORS}} | =0 | {{ERROR_STATUS}} |

### Decision: {{DECISION}}

{{DETAILS}}" }) { success } }
